verdict: Clean: the Sands' handmade floor. Cleared with four stars and no fall through the storms, no console error, every spot reachable; the wells, the caravan, the rival (Vesper, as the Codex has it), the trial, the Scarab Colossus (own model) and the gate (Sefu) all played; the people and their lines match the Codex (the Star-Reader, the Storm-Counter).

found.text: The ridge's slingers and the fort's raiders slept through the bot's route (they fight as anyone walks in: picture). The probe: 47 red rocks at the canyon foot sunk a little into the sand (nothing shows), a house at the cliff foot and a crate on the rocks with a gap the eye does not see, two shrubs on the rim.
